jobs.description:
Onze klant is een hoogtechnologisch bedrijf, een spin-off van de KUL dat fungeert als één van de grootste onderzoekscentra van Europa met verschillende uitdagingen. Onze klant is volop bezig met innovatie. Wil je mee aan de wieg staan qua ontwikkelingen naar artificiële intelligentie, nanotechnologie en ICT toe? Reageer dan snel. Wie weet krijg jij de kans om mee bij te dragen aan de technologie van morgen!

Jobomschrijving

Are you passionate about supply chain operations and ensuring materials are available when and where they are needed? Do you enjoy working with data, planning processes, and cross-functional stakeholders to keep operations running smoothly? Then this temporary opportunity could be the perfect next step in your career.

Your Challenge

As a Supply Chain Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting material planning, inventory management, and supply chain continuity. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to ensure the availability of critical materials and contribute to the optimization of supply chain processes.

What will you do?
	
• Manage material availability and inventory levels to support uninterrupted operations.	
• Maintain and optimize SAP MRP parameters.	
• Follow up on material shortages, replenishment activities, and planning actions.	
• Collaborate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues.	
• Monitor and analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.	
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to material planning and supply chain workflows.	
• Contribute to process optimization projects aimed at increasing efficiency and reliability across the supply chain.

Who are we looking for?
	
• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.	
• Experience with SAP, MRP planning, and inventory management processes.	
• Strong analytical skills and advanced knowledge of Excel.	
• Fluent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.	
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.	
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.	
• Strong attention to detail with a results-driven mindset.	
• Previous experience within the semiconductor industry is considered a strong asset.

Join an international medical non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting equitable access to resilient healthcare systems worldwide, including in Belgium, with the mission of ensuring that no one suffers or dies from preventable and treatable diseases.

The organisation operates across multiple countries, advancing public health through sustainable healthcare initiatives. It provides expert, compassionate care to people affected by tuberculosis and neglected tropical skin diseases, such as leprosy and leishmaniasis, which are closely associated with poverty, while working in close collaboration with local health systems and communities.

You lead individual donor retention strategy to maximise donor lifetime value and drive sustainable fundraising growth through data-driven donor journeys, strong donor loyalty, and an outstanding donor experience.

Your role ?

1. Individual Donor Retention Strategy

• Define and lead the long-term individual donor retention strategy,
• Own and continuously optimize the donor lifecycle (welcome, engagement, upgrade,loyalty, reactivation).
• Drive donor retention, lifetime value and sustainable individual giving revenue.
• Align retention priorities fundraising objectives

2. Donor Experience & Engagement

• Ensure a consistent, seamless and donor-centric experience across all touchpoints.
• Lead multi-channel donor stewardship and engagement initiatives.
•  Strengthen donor loyalty, advocacy and long-term commitment through personalized engagement.
•  Coordinate stakeholders involved in the donor journey to ensure consistency and impact.

3. Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Define, monitor and report on retention, engagement and lifetime value KPIs.
• Translate donor insights into strategic recommendations and improvement actions.
• Evaluate initiatives and optimize resource allocation based on impact.
• Foster a data-driven culture of continuous improvement.

4. Data-Driven Donor Journeys

• Advance the use of donor data to personalize journeys and improve decision-making
• Partner with ICT and CRM teams to ensure reliable data, segmentation and automation.
• Optimize donor journey processes through data, testing, and technology.
• Ensure donor engagement is supported by accurate, actionable and shared data.

5. Mission-led Donor Communications

• Strengthen the emotional connection between donors and Damien Foundation.
• Shape donor communications together with Brand & Acquisition to maximize engagement and loyalty.
• Ensure storytelling and engagement support long-term donor commitment and sustainable revenue growth.
• Contribute to a coherent donor experience aligned with the organization's positioning.

6. Data Governance & GDPR Compliance

• Ensure all donor engagement, retention, communication, and data management activities comply with GDPR requirements and internal data protection policies. 
• Safeguard donor privacy, consent management, data accuracy, and the secure use of personal data across all channels and systems

• You have a master's degree in marketing, Sales, Economics, Communications, or equivalent experience.
•  You have a minimum of 5 years' experience in donor engagement, individual giving, donor retention, CRM-driven marketing, or customer/donor lifecycle management, with a proven ability to design and optimize data-driven journeys that strengthen loyalty, lifetime value, and long-term support.
•  Experience in the non-profit or social impact sector is an asset.
•  You are fluent in French and Dutch, with professional proficiency in the other national language and excellent written and spoken English.
•  Strong organizational skills, with a focus on efficient processes, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
•  Strong digital mindset, with the ability to support digital transformation and leverage digital tools to achieve strategic objectives.
•  Opportunity-driven, action-oriented, and results-focused, with strong attention to detail and a proven ability to deliver long-term results.
•  Strong leadership, project management and change management skills.
•  Proven people management experience, with the ability to lead and develop teams through organizational transformation while fostering a culture of open communication and collaboration.
•  Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate donor data into actionable insights.
•  Experience with CRM systems, donor segmentation, and marketing automation.

•  Excellent writing skills and communication skills
